## VantaVault v0.5.34

Replay more utility, revisit fights, and connect to the shop through Riot Client.

### Highlights

- **Utility in Replay Theater** (utilitystates) — Watch Cypher’s wires trigger, see Killjoy activate Nanoswarm, and follow projectiles across the map.
- **Jump from a fight to the replay** (fightreplay) — Open a fight or takeaway from Match Map and check teammate positions around the fight.
- **Shop access without a Riot ID** (localaccount) — Use the shop through your signed-in Riot Client session while your account shows as Unknown.

### Added

- Open downloaded VALORANT 13.10 replays.
- See molly ground effects and individual Sage wall blocks.

### Improved

- Drag agents and utility onto the Tactics Board. Move placed pieces and routes directly on the map.
- **Renew all** includes eligible accounts that were renewed recently.
- Simultaneous pieces of one ability share a timeline entry.

### Fixed

- VantaVault keeps a known Riot ID during a failed lookup.
- Empty equipped loadouts trigger an automatic retry.

### Download

- **Windows Portable** — `VantaVault-portable.exe`
- **Windows Installer** — `VantaVault_0.5.34_x64-setup.exe`

### Auto-update

Both Windows versions update from inside VantaVault.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.33...v0.5.34)
